origin: X algorithm penalizes tweets with external links — reducing organic reach. BAE flywheel requires CTAs (Substack links, GitHub install links) to live in a reply tweet, not the thread body. cyborg-series-2026-05-15 X thread had REPLACE_WITH_SUBSTACK_URL placeholder that would have shipped broken without a gate.
description: Gate for X thread publishing. Blocks external links in main thread body, requires CTA link in reply tweet, blocks placeholder tokens, warns on weak hook.
gates: external_link_in_thread_body: any URL in main thread tweets = BLOCK (move to reply_tweet)
cta_in_reply: reply_tweet must exist and contain at least one URL = BLOCK if absent
placeholder_check: REPLACE_ tokens in thread or reply = BLOCK
hook_strength: first tweet < 50 chars or generic opener = WARN
applies_to: Any X thread in a BAE campaign
Single tweets with CTA links — check reply_tweet field
X threads where CTA link is meant to be in self-reply
litmus: Run HOW.py with thread_tweets array and reply_tweet — exit 0=safe, exit 1=blocked with remediation
